implementation_summary: AuditCrawlResult gains pacer (the HostPacer the crawl used) and crawlDelayMs (robots Crawl-delay in ms, or null). runAuditCrawl returns both; neither is exposed through AuditRequest. Tests assert the fixture's Crawl-delay of 1000 with gapMs 1000, a null delay with gapMs 500 on a site without robots.txt, and a dedicated one-page site with Crawl-delay 1.
